ask_in_screening.question: Can you describe any hands-on experience you have with phased-array or beamforming signal-processing algorithms, if any?
Can you describe any experience you have writing embedded signal-processing software in C or C++ that runs on real hardware, if any?
Can you describe any experience you have writing production Python code that is tested and maintained by a team, if any?
Can you describe any hands-on RF test-bench experience you have, such as with network analysers or spectrum analysers, if any?
